name: cartoon-shorts
description: Make vertical cartoon shorts (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Reels) that promote your app, with the real app on screen, in two styles: 2D bean story shorts and 3D toy-figure shorts. A Remotion + three.js engine plus a step-by-step skill: story, script, voice, captures, scenes, review, render and post text. Also makes TikTok photo-mode slideshows for any product from a product brief and real screenshots, on their own or from a finished short.
